in_sanskrit.name: इंद्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The deity of the sky, rain, thunderbolts, and lightning, and the king of the gods in the Hindu pantheon. He is also known as Śakra and Rudra.

in_marathi.name: Inder
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord, King, God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Inder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Inder is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘indra’, which refers to a deity in Hindu mythology.
